document.title: Security audit 2026-11-07 (9): verify-windows.ps1 re-run in the same PowerShell session

acknowledgments.summary: audit of pull request test/windows-verify before merge, directed by the maintainer

notes.title: Summary
notes.text: Audit of the fix for 'Add-Type: Cannot add type. The type NixieImage already exists', reported by the maintainer when running the script a second time in the same PowerShell window. No security issues found.

notes.title: Audit details
notes.text: The C# image helper's class name is now NixieImage_ followed by the first 6 bytes of the SHA-256 of its own source, in hex. The name is built only from that hash, so no outside input reaches the compiled code. If a type with that name is already loaded in the session (a re-run of the same version), it is reused; a changed version gets a new name. A type loaded by a different script could only match if it had the same name, which requires the same hash of the same source. The code itself is unchanged. A new CI step runs the script twice in one Windows PowerShell 5.1 session and checks both runs stop cleanly.

notes.title: Result
notes.text: No findings. Logged as required by the project's audit policy.
